policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="initObj" value="@{
			JObject loadedThrottleState = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("throttleState", null);
			JObject throttleMap = loadedThrottleState?["backends"] as JObject ?? new JObject();
			JArray backends = (JArray)context.Variables["listBackends"];
			var headers = context.Request.Headers;
			const int defaultPriority = 3;
			string priorityHeaderName = (string)context.Variables["priorityHeaderName"];
			int requestPriority = defaultPriority;
			if (headers.TryGetValue(priorityHeaderName, out var requestPriorityValues) &&
				int.TryParse(requestPriorityValues.FirstOrDefault(), out int parsedPriority) &&
				parsedPriority >= 1 && parsedPriority <= 3) {
				requestPriority = parsedPriority;
			}

			string affinityHeaderName = (string)context.Variables["AffinityHeaderName"];
			string affinityHeader = headers.GetValueOrDefault(affinityHeaderName, "");
			int affinityBackendIdx = -1;
			JArray priorityBackendIndxs = new JArray();
			DateTime now = DateTime.UtcNow;
			for (int i = 0; i < backends.Count; i++) {
				JObject backend = (JObject)backends[i];
				string affinity = backend.Value("affinity");
				DateTime wakeAt = throttleMap.Value(affinity) ?? DateTime.MinValue;
				bool isThrottling = wakeAt > now;
				backend["isThrottling"] = isThrottling;
				backend["retryAfter"] = isThrottling ? wakeAt : DateTime.MinValue;

				if (affinityBackendIdx < 0 &&
					!string.IsNullOrEmpty(affinityHeader) &&
					string.Equals(affinity, affinityHeader, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
					affinityBackendIdx = i;
				}
				if (backend["acceptablePriorities"]?.Values().Contains(requestPriority) == true) {
					priorityBackendIndxs.Add(i);
				}
			}

			JObject priorityConfig = ((JObject)context.Variables["priorityCfg"])[requestPriority.ToString()] as JObject;
			int retryCount = priorityConfig?.Value("retryCount") ?? 1;
			bool requeueAllowed = priorityConfig?.Value("requeue") ?? true;

			string policyCycleCounterHeaderName = (string)context.Variables["PolicyCycleCounterHeaderName"];
			int policyCycleCounter = 0;
			if (headers.TryGetValue(policyCycleCounterHeaderName, out var policyCycleValues) &&
				int.TryParse(policyCycleValues.FirstOrDefault(), out int parsedCounter)) {
				policyCycleCounter = parsedCounter;
			}

			string dbgStr = "";
			if (string.Equals(headers.GetValueOrDefault("S7PDEBUG", ""), "true", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
				dbgStr = "Proxy-Queue-Duration: " + headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-Request-Queue-Duration", "N/A") +
					" | Proxy-Process-Duration: " + headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-Request-Process-Duration", "N/A") +
					" | S7PID: " + headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-S7P-ID", "N/A") +
					" | " + priorityHeaderName + ": " + headers.GetValueOrDefault(priorityHeaderName, "N/A") +
					" | Priority: " + requestPriority +
					" | RequeueAllowed: " + requeueAllowed;
			}

			return new JObject {
				["RequestPriority"] = requestPriority,
				["RequestAddBackend"] = affinityBackendIdx,
				["PriBackendIndxs"] = priorityBackendIndxs,
				["RetryCount"] = retryCount,
				["RequeueAllowed"] = requeueAllowed,
				["backendCallCounter"] = 0,
				["PolicyCycleCounter"] = policyCycleCounter,
				["lastPolicyError"] = new JArray(new JObject {
					["code"] = "init",
					["message"] = "noError"
				}),
				["cntxWindowExced"] = false,
				["activityLog"] = new JArray(new JObject {
					["Elapsed"] = context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3"),
					["message"] = "Begin"
				}),
				["DbgStr"] = dbgStr
			};
		}" />
		
		<set-variable name="RetryCount" 		value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"]).Value("RetryCount"))" />
		<set-variable name="backendCallCounter" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"]).Value("backendCallCounter"))" />
		<set-variable name="PolicyCycleCounter" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"]).Value("PolicyCycleCounter"))" />
		<set-variable name="cntxWindowExced" 	value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"]).Value("cntxWindowExced"))" />

		
		
			<when condition="@(((JArray)context.Variables["listBackends"]).Any(backend => string.Equals(((JObject)backend).Value("auth"), "MI", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))">
policies.backend:
<retry condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RetryRemaining", true))" count="50" interval="1" delta="1">
			<set-variable name="PolicyCycleCounter" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("PolicyCycleCounter") + 1)" />
			
			
			<set-variable name="cycleObj" value="@{
				JObject cycleObj = new JObject();
				JObject loaded = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("throttleState", null);
				JObject state = loaded != null && loaded["backends"] != null && loaded["backends"].Type == JTokenType.Object
					? (JObject)loaded["backends"]
					: new JObject();
				JObject throttleState = new JObject { ["dirty"] = false, ["backends"] = state };
				JArray backends = (JArray)context.Variables["listBackends"];
				JArray priorityBackendIndxs = (JArray)((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"])["PriBackendIndxs"];
				JArray activityLog = (JArray)((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"])["activityLog"];
				DateTime now = DateTime.UtcNow;

				foreach (JObject backend in backends) {
					DateTime wakeAt = state.Value(backend.Value("affinity")) ?? DateTime.MinValue;
					bool isThrottling = wakeAt > now;
					backend["isThrottling"] = isThrottling;
					backend["retryAfter"] = isThrottling ? wakeAt : DateTime.MinValue;
				}

				int backendIndex = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("backendIndex", -1);
				bool callAttempted = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("callAttempted", false);
				string elapsed = context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3");
				if (backendIndex < 0 || backendIndex >= backends.Count) {
					if (callAttempted) {
						activityLog.Add(new JObject { ["Elapsed"] = elapsed, ["message"] = $"Invalid backend index: {backendIndex}" });
					} else {
						List throttled = new List();
						foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) {
							JObject backend = (JObject)backends[i];
							if (!backend.Value("isThrottling")) { continue; }
							DateTime retryAfter = backend.Value("retryAfter");
							int remainingSeconds = retryAfter > now
								? (int)Math.Ceiling((retryAfter - now).TotalSeconds)
								: 0;
							string retryAfterText = string.Format("{0:00}:{1:00}", remainingSeconds / 60, remainingSeconds % 60);
							throttled.Add(backend.Value("label") + " - " + retryAfterText);
						}
						string message = "THROTTLED: (" + (throttled.Count > 0 ? string.Join(", ", throttled) : "none") + ")";
						activityLog.Add(new JObject { ["Elapsed"] = elapsed, ["message"] = message });
					}
				} else {
					JObject backend = (JObject)backends[backendIndex];
					int lastStatusCode = context.Response?.StatusCode ?? 0;
					bool callCompleted = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("callCompleted", true);
					bool wasLimited = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("wasLimited", false);
					DateTime startTime = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("CallAttemptStartTime", now);
					double deltaSeconds = (now - startTime).TotalSeconds;
					int requestTimeout = backend.Value("timeout");
					bool likelyTimeout = deltaSeconds >= (requestTimeout * 0.9);
					string label = backend.Value("label");
					string id = backend.Value("affinity");

					if (!callCompleted) {
						bool isTempResponse = lastStatusCode == 429 || lastStatusCode == 408 || lastStatusCode >= 500;
						double retryAfterMilliseconds = backend.Value("defaultRetryAfter") * 1000.0;
						string retryAfterSource = "defaultRetryAfter=" + backend.Value("defaultRetryAfter") + "s";
						if (!wasLimited && isTempResponse && context.Response != null) {
							string retryAfterMsHeader = context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("retry-after-ms", "");
							string retryAfterHeader = context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("retry-after", "");
							int parsedMilliseconds = 0;
							int parsedSeconds = 0;
							bool hasRetryAfterMs = int.TryParse(retryAfterMsHeader, out parsedMilliseconds) && parsedMilliseconds > 0;
							bool hasRetryAfter = int.TryParse(retryAfterHeader, out parsedSeconds) && parsedSeconds > 0;
							double retryAfterMsCandidate = hasRetryAfterMs ? parsedMilliseconds + 2000.0 : 0;
							double retryAfterCandidate = hasRetryAfter ? (parsedSeconds + 2) * 1000.0 : 0;
							if (retryAfterMsCandidate >= retryAfterCandidate && hasRetryAfterMs) {
								retryAfterMilliseconds = retryAfterMsCandidate;
								retryAfterSource = "retry-after-ms=" + parsedMilliseconds + "ms + 2000ms";
							} else if (hasRetryAfter) {
								retryAfterMilliseconds = retryAfterCandidate;
								retryAfterSource = "retry-after=" + parsedSeconds + "s + 2s";
							}
						}

						bool shouldThrottlePrevious = likelyTimeout || wasLimited || isTempResponse;
						DateTime effectiveWakeAt = DateTime.MinValue;
						if (shouldThrottlePrevious) {
							DateTime wakeAt = now.AddMilliseconds(retryAfterMilliseconds);
							DateTime existingWake = state.Value(id) ?? DateTime.MinValue;
							if (wakeAt > existingWake) { state[id] = wakeAt; throttleState["dirty"] = true; }
							backend["isThrottling"] = true;
							effectiveWakeAt = state.Value(id) ?? wakeAt;
							backend["retryAfter"] = effectiveWakeAt;
						}

						int effectiveSeconds = effectiveWakeAt > now
							? (int)Math.Ceiling((effectiveWakeAt - now).TotalSeconds)
							: 0;
						string message;
						if (likelyTimeout) {
							message = $"Throttling {label} by {effectiveSeconds}s, likely timeout Elapsed: {deltaSeconds:F1}s Timeout: {requestTimeout}s Source: {retryAfterSource}";
						} else if (wasLimited) {
							message = $"Throttling {label} by {effectiveSeconds}s, concurrency limit Source: {retryAfterSource}";
						} else if (isTempResponse) {
							message = $"Throttling {label} by {effectiveSeconds}s, status {lastStatusCode} Source: {retryAfterSource}";
						} else {
							message = $"Error status {lastStatusCode} after {deltaSeconds:F1}s";
						}
						activityLog.Add(new JObject { ["Elapsed"] = elapsed, ["message"] = message });
					}
				}

				cycleObj["throttleState"] = throttleState;
				return cycleObj;
			}" />
			
			
				<when condition="@(((JObject)((JObject)context.Variables["cycleObj"])["throttleState"]).Value("dirty"))">
					
				
			
			<set-variable name="selectionObj" value="@{
				JObject selectionObj = new JObject();
				JArray backends = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("listBackends", null) ?? new JArray();
				JArray priorityBackendIndxs = (JArray)((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"])["PriBackendIndxs"];
				JArray activityLog = (JArray)((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"])["activityLog"];
				bool cntxWindowExced = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("cntxWindowExced", false);
				int retryCount = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RetryCount", 0);
				int backendIndex = -1;

				try {
					if (backends.Count > 0 && priorityBackendIndxs.Count > 0) {
						int backendCallCount = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("backendCallCounter", 0);
						if (backendCallCount == 0 && !cntxWindowExced) {
							int affinityBackendIdx = ((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"]).Value("RequestAddBackend");
							if (affinityBackendIdx >= 0 && affinityBackendIdx < backends.Count) {
								JObject affinityBackend = (JObject)backends[affinityBackendIdx];
								if (!affinityBackend.Value("isThrottling")) {
									backendIndex = affinityBackendIdx;
								}
							}
						}

						if (backendIndex < 0) {
							List availableBackends = new List();
							int lowestPriority = int.MaxValue;
							foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) {
								JObject backend = (JObject)backends[i];
								if (backend.Value("isThrottling") || (cntxWindowExced && backend.Value("label") == "PTU")) { continue; }
								int priority = backend.Value("priorityGroup");
								if (priority > lowestPriority) { continue; }
								if (priority < lowestPriority) {
									lowestPriority = priority;
									availableBackends.Clear();
								}
								availableBackends.Add(i);
							}
							if (availableBackends.Count > 0) {
								backendIndex = availableBackends[new Random(context.RequestId.GetHashCode()).Next(availableBackends.Count)];
							}
						}
					}
				} catch (Exception ex) {
					JArray errArr = (JArray)((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"])["lastPolicyError"];
					if (errArr != null) {
						errArr.Clear();
						string msg = ex.Message ?? "Exception has no Message";
						if (msg.Length > 300) { msg = msg.Substring(0, 300) + "..."; }
						errArr.Add(new JObject {
							["code"] = "backendIndex-update",
							["message"] = msg,
							["utc"] = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o")
						});
					}
					backendIndex = -1;
				}

				string shouldLimit = "off";
				try {
					if (backendIndex >= 0 && backendIndex < backends.Count) {
						shouldLimit = ((JObject)backends[backendIndex]).Value("limitConcurrency");
					}
				} catch (Exception ex) {
					JArray errArr = (JArray)((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"])["lastPolicyError"];
					if (errArr != null) {
						errArr.Clear();
						string msg = ex.Message ?? "Exception has no Message";
						if (msg.Length > 300) { msg = msg.Substring(0,300) + "..."; }
						errArr.Add(new JObject {
							["code"] = "shouldLimit-update",
							["message"] = msg,
							["utc"] = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o")
						});
					}
					shouldLimit = "off";
				}

				int unthrottledCount = 0;
				foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) {
					JObject backend = (JObject)backends[i];
					if (!backend.Value("isThrottling") && (!cntxWindowExced || backend.Value("label") != "PTU")) {
						unthrottledCount++;
					}
				}
				string retryState = retryCount == 0 ? "exhausted" : retryCount.ToString();
				activityLog.Add(new JObject {
					["Elapsed"] = context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3"),
					["message"] = $"RETRIES LEFT: {retryState} CYCLE: {context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("PolicyCycleCounter")} Unthrottled Backends: {unthrottledCount}"
				});

				bool shouldCall = backendIndex >= 0 && retryCount > 0;
				selectionObj["backendIndex"] = backendIndex;
				selectionObj["shouldLimit"] = shouldLimit ?? "off";
				selectionObj["shouldCall"] = shouldCall;
				selectionObj["RetryCount"] = retryCount;
				selectionObj["backendCallCounter"] = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("backendCallCounter", 0);

				if (shouldCall) {
					JObject selectedBackend = (JObject)backends[backendIndex];
					string requestedModel = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("model", "");
					JObject catalog = (JObject)context.Variables["backendCatalog"];
					JObject configuredBackends = string.IsNullOrEmpty(requestedModel) ? null : catalog[requestedModel] as JObject;
					string effectiveModel = configuredBackends != null && configuredBackends.Count > 0 ? requestedModel : "DEFAULT";
					string concurrencyKey = context.Api.Id + ":" + effectiveModel + ":" + selectedBackend.Value("affinity");

					selectionObj["selectedBackend"] = selectedBackend;
					selectionObj["RequestTimeout"] = selectedBackend.Value("timeout");
					selectionObj["backendUrl"] = selectedBackend.Value("url");
					selectionObj["auth"] = selectedBackend.Value("auth");
					selectionObj["RetryCount"] = retryCount - 1;
					selectionObj["backendCallCounter"] = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("backendCallCounter", 0) + 1;
					selectionObj["concurrencyKey"] = concurrencyKey;
					activityLog.Add(new JObject {
						["Elapsed"] = context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3"),
						["message"] = "Using " + selectedBackend.Value("label") + " URL: " + selectedBackend.Value("url") + " LIMIT: " + shouldLimit
					});
				} else {
					string message;
					if (priorityBackendIndxs.Count == 0) {
						message = "NO BACKENDS: none configured for priority " + ((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"]).Value("RequestPriority");
					} else if (retryCount <= 0) {
						message = "NO BACKENDS: retries exhausted";
					} else {
						DateTime now = DateTime.UtcNow;
						List throttled = new List();
						foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) {
							JObject backend = (JObject)backends[i];
							if (cntxWindowExced && backend.Value("label") == "PTU") { continue; }
							if (!backend.Value("isThrottling")) { continue; }
							DateTime retryAfter = backend.Value("retryAfter");
							int seconds = retryAfter > now ? (int)Math.Ceiling((retryAfter - now).TotalSeconds) : 0;
							throttled.Add(backend.Value("label") + " - " + string.Format("{0:00}:{1:00}", seconds / 60, seconds % 60));
						}
						message = "NO BACKENDS: unavailable (" + (throttled.Count > 0 ? string.Join(", ", throttled) : "none") + ")";
					}
					activityLog.Add(new JObject { ["Elapsed"] = context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3"), ["message"] = message });
				}

				return selectionObj;
			}" />
			<set-variable name="backendIndex" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["selectionObj"]).Value("backendIndex"))" />
			<set-variable name="shouldLimit" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["selectionObj"]).Value("shouldLimit"))" />
			
			
			
				<when condition="@(((JObject)context.Variables["selectionObj"]).Value("shouldCall"))">
					
					<set-variable name="RetryCount" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["selectionObj"]).Value("RetryCount"))" />
					
					<set-variable name="RequestTimeout" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["selectionObj"]).Value("RequestTimeout"))" />
					<set-variable name="backendUrl" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["selectionObj"]).Value("backendUrl"))" />
					<set-variable name="auth" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["selectionObj"]).Value("auth"))" />
					<set-variable name="backendCallCounter" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["selectionObj"]).Value("backendCallCounter"))" />
					<set-variable name="concurrencyKey" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["selectionObj"]).Value("concurrencyKey"))" />
					
					
					
					
					
					
					
						<when condition="@(string.Equals(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("auth", ""), "MI", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))">
							
								@("Bearer " + (string)context.Variables["managed-id-access-token"])
							
						
						<when condition="@(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("auth", "")))">
							
								@((string)context.Variables["auth"])
							
						
						
							
						
					
					

					
					
					
					
					
						<when condition="@(((JObject)context.Variables["selectedBackend"]).Value("bufferResponse"))">
							
								<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("shouldLimit", "off") == "low")">
									
										
									
								
								<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("shouldLimit", "off") == "medium")">
									
										
									
								
								<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("shouldLimit", "off") == "high")">
									
										
									
								
								
									
									
								
							
						
						
							
								<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("shouldLimit", "off") == "low")">
									
										
									
								
								<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("shouldLimit", "off") == "medium")">
									
										
									
								
								<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("shouldLimit", "off") == "high")">
									
										
									
								
								
									
									
								
							
						
					
					
					
				
			
			<set-variable name="resultObj" value="@{
				JObject resultObj = new JObject();
				JArray activityLog = (JArray)((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"])["activityLog"];
				bool callAttempted = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("callAttempted", false);
				bool callCompleted = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("callCompleted", false);
				int statusCode = context.Response?.StatusCode ?? 500;
				bool isTempError = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("isTempError", true);
				bool isPermError = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("isPermError", false);
				bool emptyResponse = false;

				if (callAttempted && callCompleted) {
					var response = context.Response;
					if (statusCode == 200 && response != null) {
						string transferEncoding = response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Transfer-Encoding", "");
						string contentLength = response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Content-Length", "");
						emptyResponse = transferEncoding.IndexOf("chunked", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) < 0 &&
							(string.IsNullOrEmpty(contentLength) || contentLength == "0" || response.Body is null);
					}

				// debug
					if (context.Response != null) {
						JObject responseHeaders = new JObject();
						foreach (var header in context.Response.Headers.OrderBy(header => header.Key, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
							JArray values = new JArray();
							foreach (string value in header.Value) {
								values.Add(value);
							}
							responseHeaders[header.Key] = values;
						}
						activityLog.Add(new JObject {
							["Elapsed"] = context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3"),
							["message"] = "StatusCode: " + statusCode + " RESPONSE HEADERS: " + responseHeaders.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None)
						});
					}
				// debug-end
				
					isTempError = statusCode == 429 || statusCode == 408 || statusCode >= 500;
					isPermError = !isTempError && statusCode >= 400 && statusCode < 500;
					if (!isTempError && !emptyResponse) {
						string statusSummary = isPermError ? "Perm Error" : "Success";
						activityLog.Add(new JObject {
							["Elapsed"] = context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3"),
							["message"] = "StatusCode: " + statusCode + " - " + statusSummary
						});
					}
				}

				bool cntxWindowExced = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("cntxWindowExced", false);
				if (context.Response != null && context.Response.StatusCode == 400) {
					try {
						JObject body = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
						cntxWindowExced = body["error"]?["code"]?.ToString() == "context_length_exceeded" || cntxWindowExced;
					} catch { }
				}

				if (cntxWindowExced) {
					isPermError = false;
					activityLog.Add(new JObject {
						["Elapsed"] = context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3"),
						["message"] = "CONTEXT WINDOW EXCEEDED: overriding 400, retrying on next host"
					});
				}

				bool shouldThrottle = callAttempted && callCompleted &&
					context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("backendIndex", -1) > -1 &&
					isTempError;

				resultObj["isTempError"] = isTempError;
				resultObj["isPermError"] = isPermError;
				resultObj["cntxWindowExced"] = cntxWindowExced;
				resultObj["emptyResponse"] = emptyResponse;
				resultObj["shouldThrottle"] = shouldThrottle;
				return resultObj;
			}" />
			<set-variable name="isTempError" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["resultObj"]).Value("isTempError"))" />
			<set-variable name="isPermError" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["resultObj"]).Value("isPermError"))" />
			<set-variable name="cntxWindowExced" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["resultObj"]).Value("cntxWindowExced"))" />
			
				<when condition="@(((JObject)context.Variables["resultObj"]).Value("shouldThrottle"))">
					
					<set-variable name="resultObj" value="@{
						JObject resultObj = (JObject)context.Variables["resultObj"];
						JObject loaded = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("throttleState", null);
						JObject map = (loaded != null && loaded["backends"] != null && loaded["backends"].Type == JTokenType.Object) ? (JObject)loaded["backends"] : new JObject();
						JObject wrapper = new JObject { ["dirty"] = false, ["backends"] = map };
						JArray backends = (JArray)context.Variables["listBackends"];
						int idx = (int)context.Variables["backendIndex"];
						if (idx < 0 || idx >= backends.Count) {
							resultObj["throttleState"] = wrapper;
							return resultObj;
						}
						JObject backend = (JObject)backends[idx];
						string id = backend.Value("affinity");

						// Use the longer valid response value, or the backend default if neither parses.
						double retryAfterMilliseconds = backend["defaultRetryAfter"].Value() * 1000.0;
						string retryAfterMsHeader = context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("retry-after-ms", "");
						string retryAfterHeader = context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("retry-after", "");
						int parsedMilliseconds = 0;
						int parsedSeconds = 0;
						bool hasRetryAfterMs = int.TryParse(retryAfterMsHeader, out parsedMilliseconds) && parsedMilliseconds > 0;
						bool hasRetryAfter = int.TryParse(retryAfterHeader, out parsedSeconds) && parsedSeconds > 0;
						if (hasRetryAfterMs || hasRetryAfter) {
							retryAfterMilliseconds = Math.Max(
								hasRetryAfterMs ? parsedMilliseconds + 2000.0 : 0,
								hasRetryAfter ? (parsedSeconds + 2) * 1000.0 : 0);
						}

						// Multi-process safe: keep the max wake time for this backend id
						DateTime newWake = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMilliseconds(retryAfterMilliseconds);
						DateTime existing = (map[id] != null && map[id].Type != JTokenType.Null) ? map[id].Value() : DateTime.MinValue;
						if (newWake > existing) { map[id] = newWake; wrapper["dirty"] = true; }

						DateTime effective = map[id].Value();
						backend["isThrottling"] = true;
						backend["retryAfter"] = effective;

						JArray activityLog = (JArray)((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"])["activityLog"];
						int remainingSeconds = effective > DateTime.UtcNow ? (int)Math.Ceiling((effective - DateTime.UtcNow).TotalSeconds) : 0;
						string retryAfterText = string.Format("{0:00}:{1:00}", remainingSeconds / 60, remainingSeconds % 60);
						string statusCode = context.Response?.StatusCode.ToString() ?? "N/A";
						activityLog.Add(new JObject {
							["Elapsed"] = context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3"),
							["message"] = "StatusCode: " + statusCode + " - Temp Error; THROTTLED: " + backend.Value("label") + " Retry-After: " + retryAfterText
						});

						resultObj["throttleState"] = wrapper;
						return resultObj;
					}" />
					
						<when condition="@(((JObject)((JObject)context.Variables["resultObj"])["throttleState"]).Value("dirty"))">
							
						
					
				
			
			<set-variable name="resultObj" value="@{
				JObject resultObj = (JObject)context.Variables["resultObj"];
				JArray backends = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("listBackends", null) ?? new JArray();
				JArray priorityBackendIndxs = (JArray)((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"])["PriBackendIndxs"];
				JArray activityLog = (JArray)((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"])["activityLog"];
				bool cntxWindowExced = resultObj.Value("cntxWindowExced");
				bool isPermError = resultObj.Value("isPermError");
				bool emptyResponse = resultObj.Value("emptyResponse");
				if (emptyResponse) {
					activityLog.Add(new JObject {
						["Elapsed"] = context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3"),
						["message"] = "StatusCode: 200 - Empty Response"
					});
				}
				int unthrottledBackends = 0;
				foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) {
					JObject backend = (JObject)backends[i];
					if (cntxWindowExced && backend.Value("label") == "PTU") { continue; }
					if (!backend.Value("isThrottling")) { unthrottledBackends++; }
				}

				int retryCount = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RetryCount", -1);
				bool requeueAllowed = ((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"]).Value("RequeueAllowed");
				bool retryRemaining = (!isPermError && retryCount > 0) && !(requeueAllowed && unthrottledBackends == 0);
				bool return429 = !isPermError && unthrottledBackends == 0 && (requeueAllowed || !retryRemaining);

				if (return429) {
					DateTime now = DateTime.UtcNow;
					List parts = new List(priorityBackendIndxs.Count);
					foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) {
						if (i < 0 || i >= backends.Count) { continue; }
						JObject backend = (JObject)backends[i];
						string label = backend.Value("label");
						if (!backend.Value("isThrottling")) {
							parts.Add(label + " ready");
							continue;
						}
						DateTime retryAfter = backend.Value("retryAfter");
						int seconds = retryAfter > now ? (int)Math.Ceiling((retryAfter - now).TotalSeconds) : 0;
						parts.Add(label + " " + string.Format("{0:00}:{1:00}", seconds / 60, seconds % 60));
					}
					activityLog.Add(new JObject {
						["Elapsed"] = context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3"),
						["message"] = "REQUEUE: RequeueAllowed=" + requeueAllowed + "; " + string.Join(", ", parts)
					});
				}

				bool terminalSuccess = false;
				bool callCompleted = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("callCompleted", false);
				if (callCompleted && context.Response != null) {
					int statusCode = context.Response.StatusCode;
					if (statusCode == 200) {
						if (!emptyResponse) {
							retryRemaining = false;
							terminalSuccess = true;
						}
					} else if (statusCode > 200 && statusCode < 400) {
						retryRemaining = false;
						terminalSuccess = true;
					}
				}

				bool shouldReturn429 = return429 || (!retryRemaining && !isPermError && !terminalSuccess);
				int sleepDuration = 1000;
				if (shouldReturn429) {
					DateTime minRetryTime = DateTime.MaxValue;
					foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) {
						if (backends[i].Value("isThrottling") && backends[i].Value("retryAfter") < minRetryTime) {
							minRetryTime = backends[i].Value("retryAfter");
						}
					}
					if (minRetryTime > DateTime.UtcNow) {
						sleepDuration = (int)Math.Min(120000, (minRetryTime - DateTime.UtcNow).TotalMilliseconds);
					}
				}

				resultObj["unThrottledBackends"] = unthrottledBackends;
				resultObj["RetryRemaining"] = retryRemaining;
				resultObj["Return429"] = return429;
				resultObj["terminalSuccess"] = terminalSuccess;
				resultObj["shouldReturn429"] = shouldReturn429;
				resultObj["sleepDuration"] = sleepDuration;
				return resultObj;
			}" />
			<set-variable name="unThrottledBackends" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["resultObj"]).Value("unThrottledBackends"))" />
			<set-variable name="RetryRemaining" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["resultObj"]).Value("RetryRemaining"))" />
			<set-variable name="Return429" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["resultObj"]).Value("Return429"))" />

			
			
				<when condition="@(((JObject)context.Variables["resultObj"]).Value("terminalSuccess"))">
					
				
				
				<when condition="@(((JObject)context.Variables["resultObj"]).Value("shouldReturn429"))">

policies.on-error:
<set-variable name="onErrorObj" value="@{
			JObject onErrorObj = new JObject();
			JObject initObj = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("initObj", null) ?? new JObject();
			JObject responseObj = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("responseObject", null) ?? new JObject();
			JArray activityLog = initObj["activityLog"] as JArray ?? new JArray();
			int statusCode = context.Response?.StatusCode ?? 500;
			bool callCompleted = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("callCompleted", false);
			int backendIndex = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("backendIndex", -1);
			bool isTempError = statusCode == 429 || statusCode == 408 || statusCode >= 500;
			bool isPermError = !isTempError && statusCode >= 400 && statusCode < 500;

			string lastErrorReason = context.LastError?.Reason ?? "";
			string lastErrorMessage = context.LastError?.Message ?? "";
			if (lastErrorMessage.Length > 200) {
				lastErrorMessage = lastErrorMessage.Substring(0, 200) + "...";
			}

			activityLog.Add(new JObject {
				["Elapsed"] = context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3"),
				["message"] = "ON ERROR ENTERED: callCompleted: " + callCompleted +
					" backendIndex: " + backendIndex +
					" unThrottledBackends: " + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("unThrottledBackends", -1) +
					" RetryRemaining: " + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RetryRemaining", true) +
					" Return429: " + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("Return429", false) +
					" LastError: " + lastErrorReason + " - " + lastErrorMessage
			});

			bool includeHandlerLog = true;
			if (callCompleted) {
				responseObj["statusCode"] = isPermError || isTempError ? statusCode : 500;
				responseObj["statusReason"] = isPermError
					? "Permanent Error"
					: (isTempError ? "Temporary Error" : "Unknown Error");
			} else {
				JArray backends = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("listBackends", null) ?? new JArray();
				JArray priorityBackendIndxs = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("initObj", null)?["PriBackendIndxs"] as JArray ?? new JArray();
				bool cntxWindowExced = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("cntxWindowExced", false);
				int unthrottledBackends = 0;

				foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) {
					if (i < 0 || i >= backends.Count) { continue; }
					JObject backend = (JObject)backends[i];
					if (cntxWindowExced && backend.Value("label") == "PTU") { continue; }
					if (!backend.Value("isThrottling")) { unthrottledBackends++; }
				}

				if (unthrottledBackends == 0) {
					responseObj["statusCode"] = 429;
					responseObj["statusReason"] = "No Backends Available";
					includeHandlerLog = false;
				} else if (backendIndex < 0 || backendIndex >= backends.Count) {
					responseObj["statusCode"] = 500;
					responseObj["statusReason"] = "Invalid Backend Index";
					includeHandlerLog = false;
				} else {
					bool wasLimited = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("wasLimited", false);
					DateTime startTime = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("CallAttemptStartTime", DateTime.UtcNow);
					double deltaSeconds = (DateTime.UtcNow - startTime).TotalSeconds;
					int requestTimeout = ((JObject)backends[backendIndex]).Value("timeout");
					bool likelyTimeout = deltaSeconds >= (requestTimeout * 0.9);

					if (likelyTimeout) {
						responseObj["statusCode"] = 408;
						responseObj["statusReason"] = "Timeout";
						statusCode = 408;
					} else if (wasLimited) {
						responseObj["statusCode"] = 429;
						responseObj["statusReason"] = "Concurrency Limit";
						statusCode = 429;
					} else {
						responseObj["statusCode"] = 500;
						responseObj["statusReason"] = "Unknown Error";
					}
				}
			}

			if (includeHandlerLog) {
				activityLog.Add(new JObject {
					["Elapsed"] = context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3"),
					["message"] = "ON ERROR HANDLER INVOKED-  callCompleted: " + callCompleted +
						" isPermError: " + isPermError +
						" isTempError: " + isTempError +
						" StatusCode: " + statusCode
				});
			}

			string backendLog = string.Join(" | ", activityLog.Select(entry =>
				((JObject)entry).Value("Elapsed") + "s " + ((JObject)entry).Value("message")
			));
			if (backendLog.Length > 4000) {
				backendLog = backendLog.Substring(0, 4000) + "...";
			}

			JArray policyErrors = initObj["lastPolicyError"] as JArray ?? new JArray();
			onErrorObj["response"] = responseObj;
			onErrorObj["backendLog"] = backendLog;
			onErrorObj["lastPolicyError"] = policyErrors.Count == 0
				? ""
				: policyErrors.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
			onErrorObj["requeueAllowed"] = initObj.Value("RequeueAllowed") ?? true;
			onErrorObj["retryAfterMs"] = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("sleepDuration", 10000);
			return onErrorObj;
		}" />
		
		<set-status code="@(((JObject)context.Variables["responseObject"]).Value("statusCode"))"
			reason="@(((JObject)context.Variables["responseObject"]).Value("statusReason"))" />
		@(((JObject)context.Variables["responseObject"]).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None))
		
			@(((JObject)context.Variables["onErrorObj"]).Value("backendLog"))
		
		
			@(((JObject)context.Variables["onErrorObj"]).Value("lastPolicyError"))
		
		
			<when condition="@(((JObject)context.Variables["onErrorObj"]).Value("requeueAllowed"))">
				
					true
				
			
		
		
			@(((JObject)context.Variables["onErrorObj"]).Value("retryAfterMs").ToString())
